installStep.name: How do you want to preview?

group.name: Previewing (just settings, change it any time)

plugin.name: When I press the key
plugin.description:
Hover an item and press the preview key, C on keyboard or R3 on controller, or use the Preview button on the item card. The piece appears on your character without equipping it.
Pressing it on several pieces stacks them, so you can put a whole outfit together and look at it before you commit to any of it.
This is the original behaviour and the one to pick if you are not sure.

plugin.name: Automatically, as I hover
plugin.description:
Moving to an apparel row previews that piece on your character straight away, with no key press.
One piece at a time, so this trades the outfit stacking above for not having to press anything.
You can change this later in the FLICK panel or with bPreviewOnHover in ApparelPreview.ini.

plugin.name: What this mod does
plugin.description:
Apparel Preview lets you see armour, clothing and jewellery on your character before you equip it, straight from the menu. In a container, barter or inventory menu, hover an item and the piece appears on you without equipping it. Nothing you are wearing changes, and nothing is written to your save.
That is all there is to it.
Source, docs and issue tracker: https://github.com/maartenharms/apparel-preview

plugin.name: An interface mod I recommend
plugin.description:
The worn preview appears on your character, on the right of the screen. So do the vanilla item card and Skyrim's own floating preview, so the thing you are trying to look at can end up behind them.
A Vel'dun-style interface layout moves both well clear of them. Not required, not a dependency.
If you use Menu Studio, its panel can hide the floating preview instead.

plugin.name: Goes well with
plugin.description:
Menu Studio pauses the world when you open a menu and stages your character, which is what makes a preview worth looking at.
Fitting Room keeps outfits as saved looks and dyes them. It and Apparel Preview know about each other: a piece you are only previewing does not take Fitting Room's dye, and previewing headgear no longer makes your head vanish when a style sits on your head slot.
Both are optional and Apparel Preview works on its own.
Thanks for installing, and if you enjoy it, a kind endorsement is always appreciated.
